description: An export of Wafi's enquiry log (rows dated 2026-05-01 to 2026-10-20) was placed on 2026-10-21 in a shared drive folder open to anyone with the link; the link was found in a public forum on 2026-11-09, the day Rawafid became aware, with views from outside accounts.
subjects_and_data: 434 students (minors) and 396 guardians: names, national IDs, dates of birth, mobile numbers, enquiry texts and 48 records with health notes.
risks_and_actions: Risks: identity misuse, exposure of children's health conditions, targeted fraud against guardians. Done: link removed and folder locked on 2026-11-09. Next: prompts minimised, log kept 90 days, exports to contractors stopped.
data_subjects_notified: Guardians will be notified without undue delay (task 5).
contact: Nasser Al-Mansour, data protection officer, Rawafid Schools Group
